title: Muscle Protein Synthesis After Exercise
subtitle: Evidence, mechanisms, practical application, progression, and safety considerations for muscle protein synthesis after exercise
evidence_strength: Established evidence from controlled trials and mechanistic studies supports the role of resistance exercise and protein intake in stimulating muscle protein synthesis. Emerging evidence relates to age-related anabolic resistance and optimal protein distribution patterns. Some variability and limitations exist due to methodological challenges in measuring MPS directly.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
